text: Checkable close-out criterion: every technical claim links its actual passing receipt; the DEC cites selected ARCH sections and the rejected MCP-now alternative without inventing outbound/host approval; core, adapter, real-vault lookup and owner usefulness have separate statuses. No pending/blocked check is marked passed and no private payload/security-report body appears in canonical documents. No whole-plan completion before its final gate passes.
why: The close-out criterion concerns canonical architecture, plan, results and decision documents outside this Git repository. Manual link/status/privacy/conformance checks and required independent document review are recorded separately. The proof tool only permits reversible mutations of tracked non-test repository files; such a mutation cannot certify canonical vault ownership, history or document claims. No passing mutation proof is asserted for this external-document criterion.
